value.title: PRD 001: daily digest
value.summary: A once-a-day summary of what the fleet did, so the operator can catch up in two minutes.

sections.name: why
sections.value: The operator comes back to a fleet that ran overnight and has to read many cards and logs to learn what happened. One short digest a day would answer that.

value.name: operator
value.need: Catch up on a day's work quickly.

value.name: prime
value.need: Point the operator at what needs a decision.

value.goal: The operator reads one file to learn what changed yesterday.

value.text: Live dashboards. The digest is written once a day.

value.title: One digest a day
value.statement: At a set hour, pij writes `digests/<yyyy-mm-dd>.md` listing merged PRs, closed seats and open questions from the last 24 hours.
value.done_when: After one day of fleet activity the digest file exists and names every PR merged that day.

value.title: Decisions first
value.statement: The digest opens with anything waiting on the operator, before the activity list.
value.done_when: A digest written while a question is open shows that question in its first section.

value.title: No cost when idle
value.statement: Writing the digest launches nothing when the fleet did nothing that day.
value.done_when: A day with no activity writes a one-line digest and the spawn counter does not move.

value.question: Which hour does the digest run?
